For query tasks, prefer one short read-only command; as soon as shell output contains the exact answer, call answer_action immediately.

Now, I will start a new problem in a new OS. My problem is:

1. Create a temporary folder named "temp_workspace_check" to hold all intermediate results and ensure it is empty before proceeding.  
2. Obtain a recursive listing of the /working hierarchy and save the raw listing to "temp_workspace_check/recursive_listing.txt".  
3. From the raw listing, extract every path whose final component is exactly "workspace" and save those paths to "temp_workspace_check/candidate_paths.txt".  
4. For each path in candidate_paths.txt, retrieve and record its filesystem metadata (including type information) into "temp_workspace_check/candidate_metadata.txt".

6. Deduplicate regular_candidates.txt, produce "temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt" with canonical paths, and write the number of unique entries to "temp_workspace_check/regular_count.txt".  
7. Perform a consistency verification that each canonical path resides under /working and that metadata matches the recorded type, writing any discrepancies to "temp_workspace_check/consistency_report.txt".  
8. Archive the intermediate artifacts (recursive_listing.txt, candidate_paths.txt, candidate_metadata.txt, regular_candidates.txt, regular_unique.txt, regular_count.txt, consistency_report.txt) into "temp_workspace_check/workspace_check_archive" and remove transient temp files while retaining the canonical files and reports.  
9. Create a control file "temp_workspace_check/final_prep.txt" summarizing the canonical regular path list, the verified count, and pointers to the archive and consistency report, preparing the state for the final decision step.

arguments:
{"script":"set -eu
WD="/working"
TD="temp_workspace_check"
mkdir -p "$TD"
# Ensure empty
rm -rf "$TD"/* || true
# 1 & 2: recursive listing
find "$WD" -print 2>/dev/null > "$TD/recursive_listing.txt" || true
# 3: extract paths whose final component is exactly "workspace"
> "$TD/candidate_paths.txt"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  bn=$(basename -- "$p")
  [ "$bn" = "workspace" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"
done < "$TD/recursive_listing.txt" > "$TD/candidate_paths.txt"
# 4: record metadata (original path, canonical, type, size, owner:group, mode, mtime)
> "$TD/candidate_metadata.txt"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    can=$(readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
    ftype=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo 'missing')
    size=$(stat -c '%s' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo '-')
    owner=$(stat -c '%U:%G' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo '-')
    mode=$(stat -c '%a' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo '-')
    mtime=$(stat -c '%Y' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo '-')
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$can" "$ftype" "$size" "$owner" "$mode" "$mtime"
  else
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "missing"
  fi
done < "$TD/candidate_paths.txt" > "$TD/candidate_metadata.txt"
# 5: filter regular files
awk -F"\t" '$3=="regular file" {print}' "$TD/candidate_metadata.txt" > "$TD/regular_candidates.txt" || true
# 6: deduplicate canonical paths and count
awk -F"\t" '$3=="regular file" && $2!="" {print $2}' "$TD/candidate_metadata.txt" | sed 's:/*$::' | sort -u > "$TD/regular_unique.txt" || true
wc -l < "$TD/regular_unique.txt" | awk '{print $1}' > "$TD/regular_count.txt" || true
# 7: consistency verification
> "$TD/consistency_report.txt"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  # Check resides under /working
  under="yes"
  case "$p" in
    $WD/*|$WD) under="yes" ;;
    *) under="no" ;;
  esac
  if [ "$under" != "yes" ]; then
    printf 'NOT_UNDER_WORKING\t%s\n' "$p" >> "$TD/consistency_report.txt"
    continue
  fi
  # Check exists
  if [ ! -e "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ]; then
    printf 'MISSING\t%s\n' "$p" >> "$TD/consistency_report.txt"
    continue
  fi
  actual=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo 'missing')
  if [ "$actual" != "regular file" ]; then
    printf 'TYPE_MISMATCH\t%s\texpected:regular file\tactual:%s\n' "$p" "$actual" >> "$TD/consistency_report.txt"
  fi
done < "$TD/regular_unique.txt"
# 8: archive intermediate artifacts
ARCH="$TD/workspace_check_archive.tar.gz"
# Files to archive (if they exist)
files="recursive_listing.txt candidate_paths.txt candidate_metadata.txt regular_candidates.txt regular_unique.txt regular_count.txt consistency_report.txt"
cd "$TD"
# Only add existing files
args=""
for f in $files; do [ -e "$f" ] && args="$args $f"; done
if [ -n "$args" ]; then
  tar -czf "$(basename "$ARCH")" $args 2>/dev/null || true
fi
# Remove transient temp files while retaining canonical files and reports
rm -f recursive_listing.txt candidate_paths.txt candidate_metadata.txt regular_candidates.txt || true
# 9: final_prep.txt
{
  echo "Canonical regular paths:"
  [ -s regular_unique.txt ] && cat regular_unique.txt || echo "(none)"
  echo
  echo -n "Verified count: "
  [ -s regular_count.txt ] && cat regular_count.txt || echo "0"
  echo
  echo "Archive: $ARCH"
  echo "Consistency report: $TD/consistency_report.txt"
} > final_prep.txt
# Decide yes/no: if any canonical regular path exists under /working
count=0
if [ -s regular_unique.txt ]; then
  count=$(wc -l < regular_unique.txt | tr -d '[:space:]') || count=0
fi
if [ "$count" -ge 1 ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
